# Lime Digital Institute — Full Program & Institute Documentation

## Overview
Lime Digital Institute (LDI) is Rajkot's leading educational institute for practical digital marketing, performance advertising, and artificial intelligence automation. Founded with the mission to eliminate theoretical-only marketing education, LDI teaches students and business owners through live ad budgets, real Indian brand case studies, and agency simulations.

## Curriculum & 16 Modules
1. Website Creation & Conversion Architecture (WordPress, Elementor, Landing Page CRO)
2. Search Engine Optimization (Technical SEO, On-Page, Off-Page, Schema Markup, GEO)
3. Performance Paid Ads (Meta Ads Manager, Campaign Budget Optimization, Scaling)
4. Search Advertising (Google Ads, Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping)
5. AI-Powered Marketing (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini prompt engineering, creative automation)
6. Marketing Automation & Workflows (n8n, Zapier, Webhooks, Zoho CRM integration)
7. Content Marketing & Copywriting (Direct-response copywriting, storytelling, video scripts)
8. Social Media Marketing (Organic Instagram, LinkedIn personal branding, viral formats)
9. E-commerce Marketing (Shopify, Amazon Ads, Catalog Sales, Retention)
10. Analytics & Data-Driven Growth (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Server-Side Tracking)
11. Lead Generation & Funnels (B2B lead generation, WhatsApp funnels, email automation)
12. Influencer Marketing & PR (Affiliate campaigns, brand outreach, contract management)
13. Mobile Marketing & App Growth (App store optimization, push campaigns)
14. Local SEO & Google Business Profile (Map pack ranking, local citations, review generation)
15. Agency Business & Freelancing (Client acquisition, pricing, pitching, retainer models)
16. Capstone Live Project & Portfolio Defense (Live campaign execution with real ad spend)

## Key Stats & Social Proof
- 800+ Students Placed
